verdict.detail: The album's main issue on Discogs isn't vinyl; this is from the first year it was pressed on vinyl, one of 4 that year.

cutters: Glass Mastered at Arvato Digital Services

notes.text:
Limited Edition Super Deluxe Box Set. 
Includes: 3 Vinyl LPs, 2CDs with 48 page hard-bound book and exclusive poster.

Two piece lift-off lid type box, plus a matte black card holding tray affixed to the base section.
The lid section has spot gloss varnish detail to the artist, title and border. There is no spine text. Artwork continues at the interior section of the lid.
The two CDs are housed in a hardback art book which also features lyrics, credits etc. The front and spine of the book also have spot gloss varnish detail. The book is held in a recess of the holding tray.
There is a 24" square artwork poster, printed on one side only.
The LPs have picture labels. Each disc was originally held in a PVC sleeve with a lip.
If stored for long periods, copies may be prone to develop fogging to the playing surface, as a phenomenon of the vinyl disc being stored in a PVC (vinyl) sleeve.
There is a 2" circular hype sticker applied directly to the lid section, within the shrink-wrap.

℗ & © 2008 Sony BMG Music Entertainment (UK) Limited.
Made in the EU.

Vinyl runouts are hand etched.
